## `_set_project_name`
Returns a bool indicating whether a name was explicitly set. ## `_ask_for_project_name`
Prompts via `input(...)`. An empty entry raises `ConfigurationError` stating `"The project name cannot be empty."` (plus a docs link); otherwise it stores the input.

Clears the API key, sets the default workspace, and works through steps: use a provided active URL, detect the default local instance, and (in interactive/auto modes) confirm reuse. Non-interactive sessions without a URL raise `ConfigurationError`. Finally it may prompt for a URL and save config.

## `_configure_cloud`
Runs `_set_api_key`, `_set_workspace`, and `_set_project_name`, then saves config only if any of these signaled a change. Otherwise it updates the session without saving, sets integration env vars, and logs that Opik is already configured. Ends by logging the project message.

Wrapped in try/except. When `save_to_file` is true, it builds and saves a new `OpikConfig` (falling back to default workspace/project names). It always updates session config for `api_key`, `url_override`, `workspace`, and `project_name`; failures raise `ConfigurationError`.
